scope_description: Step 4 (KDS receives kiosk order with source field) + Step 6 (status transitions ACCEPT/PREPARING/PREPARED visible on KDS — kitchen release rule, TZ-aware boundaries, polling fallback parity with broadcast).

invariants_verified.title: Kiosk orders DO appear on KDS — Order vs FrontendOrder model unify on `orders` table
invariants_verified.expectation: KdsSyncService queries the same physical table where kiosk FrontendOrder rows are written. Two Eloquent models, one table; no kiosk-vs-pos write split.
invariants_verified.evidence: app/Models/Order.php:19 and app/Models/FrontendOrder.php:19 both declare `protected $table = 'orders'`. KdsSyncService.php:82 queries `Order::with(['orderItems', 'address', 'user'])` — kiosk-written rows are surfaced unconditionally.

invariants_verified.title: Active-window filter includes the three statuses KDS displays — ACCEPT / PREPARING / PREPARED
invariants_verified.expectation: KdsSyncService.php active-status filter must mirror KitchenReleaseRule::visibleStatuses() so the polling fallback parity-matches the broadcast-driven realtime path.
invariants_verified.evidence: KdsSyncService.php:50 `$activeStatuses = [OrderStatus::ACCEPT, OrderStatus::PREPARING, OrderStatus::PREPARED]`. KitchenReleaseRule.php:16-23 returns identical array.

invariants_verified.title: Kiosk cash auto-accept dispatches OrderCreated immediately (kitchen preps while customer queues at counter)
invariants_verified.expectation: PENDING_COUNTER cash flow auto-accepts at FrontendOrder creation, dispatches OrderCreated, KDS receives Echo broadcast OR polling delta picks it up.
invariants_verified.evidence: FrontendOrderService.php:577-581 sets status=ACCEPT inside the create transaction when $shouldAutoAcceptAfterCreate=$isCounterDeferredKioskCash. :604-606 dispatches dispatchNewOrderSignals (which fires OrderCreated:1226) when $shouldDispatchNewOrderSignals=true (cash kiosk meets the gate). KDS-side: admin-kds.js:1605-1608 subscribes to broadcastAs='OrderCreated' → _debouncedRefresh.

invariants_verified.title: Kiosk card/TR deferred dispatch — OrderCreated fires only after TPE confirmation
invariants_verified.expectation: Card / TR kiosk orders stay PENDING + UNPAID at creation. OrderCreated dispatches AT finalizePaidKioskOrder (after paymentConfirm flips ps=PAID and seq is allocated).
invariants_verified.evidence: FrontendOrderService.php:209-235 documents the gate. :1212 calls dispatchNewOrderSignals after successful promotion. KitchenReleaseRule.php:56-72 enforces 'released to kitchen' = status >= ACCEPT AND ps=PAID (or POS cash special-case). No kiosk card order can leak to KDS pre-payment.

invariants_verified.title: Status transition rule — only ACCEPT→PREPARING and PREPARING→PREPARED dispatch OrderStatusChanged
invariants_verified.expectation: Backward / out-of-band transitions blocked; identical-to-identical bumps don't fire spurious broadcasts.
invariants_verified.evidence: KitchenReleaseRule.php:41-49 canTransition(): explicit (ACCEPT→PREPARING) || (PREPARING→PREPARED). :51-54 shouldDispatchStatusChanged returns false for from===to. DispatchKdsTicket.php:13-17 honours this gate before OrderStatusChanged::dispatch.

invariants_verified.title: KDS TZ-aware active window — Paris-local day bounds converted to UTC before binding (kiosk + POS both honored)
invariants_verified.expectation: Carbon::today/tomorrow in app.timezone (Europe/Paris) must be normalized to UTC before binding to `order_datetime` (TIMESTAMP UTC-stored). Otherwise nightly [00:00-02:00 Paris] orders silently drop off KDS.
invariants_verified.evidence: KdsSyncService.php:77-94 — $parisTodayStartUtc / $parisTodayEndUtc / $parisTomorrowStartUtc computed via Carbon::today(\$appTz)->setTimezone('UTC'). Heal documented at :66-76 as Wave 3 KDS Adversarial P0 KDS-ADV3-01, ref commit 148dbebce. Sentinel: tests/Feature/Kds/KdsSyncTzAwareTest.php (referenced).

invariants_verified.title: 5s cache key salted with branch_id — no cross-tenant cache poisoning
invariants_verified.expectation: kds.sync.{branch}.{minute}.{hash(since|include_deleted)} — branch A's polling cannot pull branch B's payload.
invariants_verified.evidence: KdsSyncService.php:42-47 cache key includes $cacheBranchKey (=branchId or 'all'); :49 Cache::remember TTL=5s. KdsSyncController.php:55-66 enforces cross-branch refusal (403) unless admin (branch_id=0).

invariants_verified.title: Polling fallback parity — admin-kds.js falls back to GET /admin/kds/sync when Echo subscription fails
invariants_verified.expectation: Echo subscription failure (Pusher/Soketi outage, auth fail) does not silence KDS — polling picks up via the same sync endpoint with `since` cursor.
invariants_verified.evidence: admin-kds.js:1636-1638 catches Echo subscription failure and logs warning. Surrounding refreshOrderList logic at :1653 issues this.items() (the polling GET). Resource enrichment with `version` (KdsSyncService.php:105-116) is identical on both polling and event-driven refreshes (KDSOrderDetailsResource emits the same shape).

invariants_verified.title: include_deleted=true emits ids that left the active window — KDS removes them locally without flicker
invariants_verified.expectation: When status transitions out of [ACCEPT/PREPARING/PREPARED] or soft-delete fires, the next sync delta includes the lost id in deleted_ids[] so the frontend prunes its local cache.
invariants_verified.evidence: KdsSyncService.php:120-138 merges Order::onlyTrashed() with status in inactiveStatuses [DELIVERED, CANCELED, REJECTED], unique-flat-ints. branch_id scoped. KdsSyncController.php:68-73 parses include_deleted with FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOL default true.

invariants_verified.title: Per-order `version` stamp drives idempotent client-side reconciliation
invariants_verified.expectation: Frontend compares per-order version (updated_at_unix); if stale, ignore; if newer, replace.
invariants_verified.evidence: KdsSyncService.php:151-167 computeOrderVersion = updated_at->getTimestamp(). :112-114 merges version into each KDSOrderDetailsResource. TODO at :154-159 flags Phase 3 dette technique on status_changed_at column (max() with updated_at).

invariants_verified.title: Kiosk orders actually present in active KDS window — runtime smoke
invariants_verified.expectation: At least one kiosk-flagged order currently visible to KDS (status in PREPARING/PREPARED) to confirm the path is live, not just static-valid.
invariants_verified.evidence: DB query: 22 kiosk-flagged orders (source_surface='kiosk') currently in status PREPARING(7) or PREPARED(8) on branch=1. Full distribution: PENDING=11, ACCEPT=99, CANCELED=18, PREPARING=20, PREPARED=2, DELIVERED=2.

findings.title: KdsSyncService limit(50) on active-window — large branches with >50 concurrent open orders may silently truncate

evidence.code: KdsSyncService.php:102 `->limit(50)->get()` — applied after status / date / branch filters, ordered by updated_at desc.
evidence.behavior: If branch_id=1 (mature Le Cayenne) has 55 active orders, the 5 with the oldest updated_at silently drop off the polling delta. Echo broadcast path (debouncedRefresh on every OrderCreated/OrderStatusChanged) still re-fetches via the same /list endpoint with the same limit.
evidence.current_state: Single-restaurant Le Cayenne has 22 currently active — far below 50. Won't trigger today. Worth flagging for V1.0.2 SaaS rollout (multi-tenant volume).
evidence.kitchen_display_endpoint_parity: Cross-reference KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService::list (mentioned in code comments) for its own limit / pagination posture — may have a different limit and the two should agree.

findings.impact: Currently zero (Le Cayenne 22 < 50). Latent for SaaS V1.0.2 multi-branch tenants with high throughput.
remediation_options: Bump limit to 200 (still cheap given indexed filter set).
Replace limit with explicit pagination contract (`since` cursor already exists; add `next_since` in response).
Add log warning if returned count == limit (signals truncation event for ops dashboards).
findings.confidence: MEDIUM (depends on operational scale; static analysis only)

findings.title: version stamp is updated_at-derived — silent updates that don't bump updated_at could leak a stale card

evidence.code: KdsSyncService.php:151-167 — already self-acknowledged TODO referencing Phase 3 dette technique D-03bis. version=updated_at_unix. Order status changes via the standard Eloquent ->save() flow DO bump updated_at, so the common case is fine.
evidence.edge: DB-level writes (e.g. soft-delete in a different process, raw SQL admin patch, model::update() with timestamps disabled) could change status without bumping updated_at — KDS clients with the stale version would not refresh.
evidence.scope: Self-acknowledged in code comments at lines 152-158.

findings.impact: Self-flagged dette technique. Triggers only on out-of-band writes — uncommon but possible during ops incidents.
remediation_options: Until then, ensure all status updates go through OrderStateMachine::recordTransition + ->save() (already pattern-enforced).

findings.title: KdsSyncService eager-loads orderItems/address/user — N+1 protected, but no select() projection

evidence.code: KdsSyncService.php:82 — `Order::with(['orderItems', 'address', 'user'])->select(*)` (implicit *). No column projection on the parent Order.
evidence.impact: Each row hydrates full Order model (~30+ columns). At 22 active orders this is negligible. At 200+ on a busy SaaS tenant the wire payload grows linearly.

findings.impact: Negligible at Le Cayenne scale. Latent observability concern for SaaS.
remediation_options: Add explicit select() projection mapping exactly the columns KDSOrderDetailsResource::toArray reads.
Add an integration test asserting payload byte size < threshold for a fixed dataset.

verdict.summary: KDS reception of kiosk orders is solid. Polling fallback + Echo broadcast parity verified. TZ-aware boundaries fixed at Wave 3 (148dbebce heal). KitchenReleaseRule enforces release semantics consistently between immediate (cash) and deferred (card/TR) kiosk paths. No P0 blockers. Two P2 items (limit(50) latent scale, version=updated_at self-acknowledged dette) and one P3 (column projection).
verdict.production_readiness: GO at Le Cayenne single-tenant scale. P2 limit(50) item is V1.0.2 SaaS-rollout concern.
